title: The Van You Cannot See
hook: The right mirror has him. The seat does not.
scene: Clear cold afternoon on West Valley. You already signaled left. The right door mirror has a white van in it — close, same way, no lamps. Turn your head: from the seat he is gone. That empty stretch beside the box is the blind spot. The glass can have him and the seat can still be empty. Nudge right to make the left feel bigger and you hit him. Take the left anyway and he can stay on the box and come with you.
decision: The right mirror has a van you still cannot see from the seat. What do you do?

options.text: Cancel, hold the lane, let him show or fall back, then take a clean gap
options.result: You kill the blinker and hold. He appears in the inside mirror a second later, then drops. The next gap is empty. You take it without writing him into the steel.

options.text: Finish the left — he is on the right, so the left is empty
options.result: You take the left anyway. He was tucked on the right of the box, and he stays there as you move. Now you are both in the new lane and you still cannot see him. Steel on steel.

options.text: Drift right first to square up, then take the left
options.result: You drift right to get a better look. He is already in that space. The side of the bus takes the van.

options.text: Tap the horn so he knows to get out of the mirror
options.result: The horn on Central. He flinches into you. You both stop in a live lane. Everything behind has to lift.

debrief: The right mirror can show a van the seat still cannot see. That is the blind spot. Kill the blinker, hold, then take a gap you have swept. Wait until he is a van you can see.

source.psdp_skill: Skill nine: multi-lane roads – part one
source.teaching_target: Recheck the blind zone during a lane change; do not drift into a vehicle the side mirror already showed.
